svg.title: Fisher information of a coin
svg.desc: Left: the average log-likelihood of a coin as a function of the guessed probability, for data with true probability 0.5 (blue) and 0.1 (orange), shifted to a common peak, with the parabola of curvature I(θ) dashed. The θ = 0.1 curve is much sharper: 11.1 against 4. Right: I(θ) = 1/(θ(1 − θ)), smallest at a fair coin, with dots at 1/(N Var(MLE)) from simulations at θ = 0.5 and 0.2, which sit on the curve.
